reason: The paper distills a simulated air-hockey world-model policy into a 64-state diagonal linear recurrence, finding similar control performance to GRU with 88% fewer recurrent-core parameters and lower computation across five seeds. The authors limit conclusions to one simulated task, teacher, state size, and blackout horizon. This is robotics control, not LLM inference; only a weak recurrence-efficiency analogy remains.
title: Linear Recurrent Memory Suffices to Distil a World-Model Policy for Robot Air Hockey
